episode.title: Cap shell-tool output truncation to the remaining model context budget
episode.before: At parent commit 4f91037af49556763fe3e5bd15a71016a5b69e88, Config.getTruncateToolOutputThreshold() returned only the configured truncation threshold. Consequently, the shell-result handling call site could pass that fixed threshold to truncation even when it exceeded the model context window remaining after the last prompt.
episode.after: At b416508ef1c64db6cdac2f185afa579368c353cf, Config.getTruncateToolOutputThreshold() returns the smaller of the configured threshold and four times the difference between the active model's token limit and the last prompt token count. The existing shell-result handling call site therefore truncates against a character estimate of the remaining context whenever that estimate is smaller, while preserving lower default or custom caps.
episode.diff: The change imports the model token-limit resolver and UI prompt-token telemetry into the configuration module, replaces the fixed threshold getter with Math.min(4 * (tokenLimit(model) - lastPromptTokenCount), configuredThreshold), and adds three unit-test cases covering a remaining-context cap, retention of a smaller default cap, and retention or override of a custom cap. No shell scheduler code was changed; its existing threshold consumer automatically receives the adaptive value.

evidence_units.claim: Commit b416508ef1c64db6cdac2f185afa579368c353cf is the implementation-bearing resolution linked to issue/PR 8379, has parent 4f91037af49556763fe3e5bd15a71016a5b69e88, and changes config.ts plus config.test.ts.
evidence_units.source: issue-bundle.json linked_pull_requests[0], resolved_commit, parent_commit, changed_files_name_status; git show --stat --format=fuller b416508ef1c64db6cdac2f185afa579368c353cf

evidence_units.claim: The parent implementation of Config.getTruncateToolOutputThreshold() returned this.truncateToolOutputThreshold without considering model capacity or current prompt usage.

The resolved implementation computes Math.min(4 * (tokenLimit(this.model) - uiTelemetryService.getLastPromptTokenCount()), this.truncateToolOutputThreshold), documenting the factor as an estimate that one token is approximately four characters.
The token-limit resolver supplies model-specific context limits and a default limit, providing the total-capacity input used by the adaptive threshold calculation.
evidence_units.source: packages/core/src/core/tokenLimits.ts at b416508ef1c64db6cdac2f185afa579368c353cf, tokenLimit and DEFAULT_TOKEN_LIMIT

evidence_units.claim: The UI telemetry service exposes getLastPromptTokenCount(), which returns its recorded last-prompt token count and supplies the consumed-context input to the calculation.

When a successful tool result is string content from the shell tool and truncation is enabled, the core tool scheduler obtains Config.getTruncateToolOutputThreshold() and passes that value to truncateAndSaveToFile; therefore the changed getter directly controls the shell-output truncation boundary.
A unit test sets a 32,000-token limit and 1,000-token prompt count and expects a 124,000-character threshold instead of the 4,000,000 default.
evidence_units.source: git show b416508ef1c64db6cdac2f185afa579368c353cf -- packages/core/src/config/config.test.ts, test 'should return the calculated threshold when it is smaller than the default'

evidence_units.claim: A unit test expects the 4,000,000 default threshold to remain in force when the calculated remaining-context estimate is 6,000,000 characters.
evidence_units.source: git show b416508ef1c64db6cdac2f185afa579368c353cf -- packages/core/src/config/config.test.ts, test 'should return the default threshold when the calculated value is larger'

evidence_units.claim: A unit test verifies that a custom 50,000-character threshold is reduced to 24,000 when remaining context is smaller and remains 50,000 when remaining context is larger.
evidence_units.source: git show b416508ef1c64db6cdac2f185afa579368c353cf -- packages/core/src/config/config.test.ts, test 'should use a custom truncateToolOutputThreshold if provided'

evidence_units.claim: The added tests collectively validate both sides of the minimum operation for default and custom configured caps, but the available evidence does not include an executed test result or an end-to-end shell-output test added by this commit.
evidence_units.source: Inspection of the three added tests in packages/core/src/config/config.test.ts and the two-file commit stat for b416508ef1c64db6cdac2f185afa579368c353cf

candidate_atomics.name: bound-output-threshold-by-remaining-context
candidate_atomics.description: Derive an output-size threshold from remaining context capacity and clamp the configured threshold to that dynamic bound before the output consumer performs truncation.

semantic_action.intent: Prevent a large tool result from being admitted under a static output threshold that is larger than the context capacity remaining after the current prompt.
semantic_action.pre_state: Output truncation uses a configured character threshold, while the runtime can provide both the active model's token capacity and the last prompt's token consumption.
semantic_action.post_state: The effective output threshold is no greater than either the configured cap or the estimated remaining context expressed in characters.
semantic_action.validation: Mock total token capacity and consumed prompt tokens, then assert the effective threshold equals the remaining-context estimate when smaller and equals the default or custom configured cap when that cap is smaller.

candidate_workflows.name: make-tool-output-truncation-context-aware
candidate_workflows.description: Replace a purely static tool-output boundary with an effective boundary capped by estimated remaining context, while retaining existing lower configuration limits and leaving the output consumer unchanged.

workflow_graph.goal: Ensure shell output is truncated before its allowed size can exceed the model context budget remaining after the latest prompt.
workflow_graph.entry_state: The shell-result consumer already supports truncation and obtains its threshold from configuration, but that getter returns only a fixed configured value.
workflow_graph.exit_state: The existing consumer receives the minimum of its configured character cap and an estimate of remaining context capacity, with unit coverage for dynamic, default-cap, and custom-cap outcomes.
unresolved_or_deferred: No execution result for the unit-test suite is present in the checkout or GitHub evidence bundle.
No newly added end-to-end test demonstrates an oversized shell result flowing through the scheduler and truncation utility.
Behavior when the recorded prompt token count exceeds the model token limit, which would produce a negative calculated threshold, is not covered by the added tests.
The four-characters-per-token conversion is explicitly an estimate and is not validated for different content distributions.

unresolved_questions: Did CI or a local run execute and pass packages/core/src/config/config.test.ts for this commit? The supplied evidence lacks status-check and test-execution metadata.

Should the remaining-context calculation be clamped at zero when the last prompt token count is greater than the model token limit? The implementation and tests do not establish that boundary behavior.

Does using only the last prompt token count fully represent the context already occupied at the shell-output admission point? The available implementation evidence establishes the chosen signal but not its completeness.
